facts.fact: AdWave states that programmatic buying lets advertisers start TV advertising with $50 rather than $50,000.
facts.quote: Programmatic buying lets you start with $50, not $50,000.

facts.fact: AdWave's article presents a 60-day standout plan for local businesses, with eight weeks of listed activities.
facts.quote: Putting It Together: A 60-Day Standout Plan

facts.fact: The article recommends surveying 10 customers by asking why they chose the business as the first step of its 60-day plan.
facts.quote: Survey 10 customers: "Why did you choose us?"

facts.fact: The AdWave article was published on July 25, 2025.
